t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are all linked, they show up in the same pairs and one type of gnome will lead to a light one and the other will lead to a dark one, you have to figure out which one gives the most mushrooms. only the colour of the gnomes are relevant

vb_textbox.text: Hello, just a little adviceThe orange, green, red and blue gnomes all send you to the same place, the other gnomes will send you to another place, forrests are either light or dark depending on which one you pick. The ammount of mushrooms are either higher or lower depending on which place you pick, but they swap after a few rounds it wont always be the higher number. Good luck!
